fields.description: Automatic series for the request number.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: The work volunteers are being asked for. It carries what a candidate must hold, and whether the request needs approval.
fields.label: Terms of Reference

fields.description: Where the volunteers are needed, and where the request routes for approval.
fields.label: Geo Node

fields.description: How many volunteers are being asked for. What was asked for, not a quota the roster is held to.
fields.label: Volunteers Requested

fields.description: The first day the volunteers are needed. Certifications are checked against this date when candidates are matched.
fields.label: Needed From

fields.description: The last day the volunteers are needed. Never earlier than the first.
fields.label: Needed Until

fields.description: Why these volunteers are needed, in your own words. Read by whoever approves the request.
fields.label: Justification

fields.description: The deployment this request became. Empty until the request is settled.
fields.label: Deployment

fields.description: Where the approval stands. Set by the approval engine, and left at Draft where the terms ask for no approver.
fields.label: Approval State
fields.options:
Draft
Submitted
In Review
Approved
Rejected
Withdrawn
Expired

fields.description: The approval stage under review. Set by the approval engine.
fields.label: Approval Stage

fields.description: When the current approval stage was entered. Used to measure how long a decision is taking.
fields.label: Stage Entered On

fields.description: Who decided what, when and why. Written by the approval engine.
fields.label: Approval Decisions

fields.description: Show this need to volunteers on the portal. Off until somebody publishes it, and the justification is never shown.
fields.label: Advertise to Volunteers
